images.caption: Figure 1:Visible identity labels degrade cooperation.In this work we place agents from several open-weight model families in cooperation games and vary only what they know about each other. When the family label is visible the group splits into label-aligned communities, and spends on average55%55\%more tokens to reach a decision; when no identity metadata is shown, neither happens.
